name: Admin Tooltips
description: Adds a per-field 'Tooltip settings' text box to the Manage form display, and renders that text as a hover tooltip next to the field widget on entry forms to guide editors.
project_description: Admin Tooltips provides a way to attach a tooltip text to fields in Drupal forms from the Manage form display settings (e.g. /admin/structure/types/manage/article/form-display). Open a field's widget settings, enter the text under Tooltip settings, update and save; the text then appears as a hover tooltip (an info icon and pop-out) next to that widget on the entity add/edit form. The tooltip markup uses a template and CSS that can be overridden from the site theme.
